objective: Build the 19 Blender creature models creature_<id> to the section 9.1 contract, add them to the manifest, the generated GardenAssets module, the register and the Blender plan.
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json has 19 creature_<id> entries, one mesh each, origin at the base centre, front on Blender -Y, height 2.8 to 6 studs and x, z within 6 at Normal size, tris within 3000 (GardenAssets.spec.luau pins size and parts to the manifest and checks the height and footprint band)
src/shared/GardenAssets.luau is regenerated by tools/blender/write-assets-module.mjs garden, model ids nil until the Director's upload step runs
docs/assets/register.md has one row per model (studio-owned original work, as the egg rows) before any id is used
docs/assets/garden-blender-plan.md lists the 19 models with their target heights and the lineup preview
No file outside files changes; lune run tests/run GardenAssets passes
verification: CI (GardenAssets.spec), A15 looks at the lineup preview against the band and the GDD names
notes: Two artists share this task; split by species, one PR each is fine as long as each PR regenerates GardenAssets.luau. Code never waits for a model: Models.nightReady keeps the old mesh or the part fallback until an id is uploaded (GARDEN-025 wires the loading).
